scope: All methods registered by the four native renderer method tables; shared helper functions reachable from these entries.
count_note: Repository method tables currently register 52 callable entries; inventory includes all discovered exports.

shared_risks.details: Known palette floor-to-int conversion and ElectricStorm geometry casts were hardened. Other bounded conversions rely on per-kernel constraints; the full set has not been proven.
Known frame and index products were widened or reduced. Remaining expressions across all entries require a formal per-expression overflow audit.
NumPy dtype/rank/alignment/contiguity/writability checks and overlap checks exist; a proof for maximum representable ndarray byte lengths and every offset is outstanding.
Sequence references observed in relevant paths are decref-ed, but allocation-failure injection and exhaustive control-flow ownership proof were not completed.

Common validators enforce expected type, shape, alignment, contiguity and writability where used. Per-entry validation coverage is reflected below; some scalar-only and helper-mediated paths remain to inspect.
Focused ASan/UBSan tests do not prove invalid input cannot terminate the process across all 52 entry points.
